observations: Photo 0 shows a yellow gas cylinder with a partially legible label and some handwritten/painted marks near the neck; no kg or test-date stamp is clearly readable.
Photo 1 shows a different, blue gas cylinder with a visible brand mark reading 'BERADISCO' on the body.
Photo 2 shows the same blue cylinder from another angle, valve and collar visible, but no capacity or date-of-manufacture stamp is legible.
The listing text claims a single '12.5kg standard Cooking Gas Cylinder' but two visually different cylinders (different color, different brand) appear across the three photos.
No gas level, weight scale, or regulator/hose is shown in any photo.
Surface shows scuffs, paint wear, and some rust-colored staining near the base and neck in both cylinders.

identity.brand: BERADISCO (visible on blue cylinder only, photo 1)

claims.evidence: No capacity stamp or scale reading is legible in any photo; also two different cylinders appear in the set, making it unclear which one (or both) is being sold.

risks.risk: Two different cylinders (yellow vs blue 'BERADISCO') shown under one listing — unclear if buyer receives one or the mismatch is a listing error.
risks.proof: A single photo showing both cylinders together, or a clear statement/photo confirming which one is for sale.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower-value/less certain item, and purchase withheld until clarified

risks.risk: Cylinder capacity (12.5kg) not visible on body stamp or neck ring.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped capacity/tare weight and manufacture/test date ring on the cylinder neck.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified capacity, worst case treated as a smaller/non-standard size

risks.risk: Valve condition and leak-tightness cannot be assessed from photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photo/video of the valve with soapy-water leak test or a working regulator attached.
risks.if_unproven: priced as valve condition unknown/needs replacement

risks.risk: Cylinder may be empty, underfilled, or expired for recertification (LPG cylinders need periodic revalidation).
risks.proof: Photo of weighing scale with cylinder, and close-up of last test/recertification stamp.

risks.risk: Internal/external corrosion or dents not visible from current angles (only top/neck shown).
risks.proof: Full side and base photos in good light showing the entire body for dents or rust-through.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having visible wear, worst case moderate corrosion

proof_requests: Clarify and photograph which single cylinder is actually for sale (yellow or blue).
Close-up of the capacity/tare-weight stamp and test-date ring on the cylinder neck.
Photo of the cylinder on a weighing scale to confirm current gas content.
Full-body side photos in good lighting showing base and seams for corrosion/dents.
Video of valve with regulator attached showing no hiss/leak.
response.reason: The listing shows two visually distinct cylinders under one description, and no photo confirms the stated 12.5kg capacity, fill level, or valve/body condition, so even a worst-case price cannot be set until the mismatch is resolved and key stamps are shown.
